description_en: Creates a rebooking order for an international flight ticket
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen intl-flight-re-shop-create --ota-item-id d01eb358456b4ba38eb4d8f1499186da_0 --passenger-journey-group-key edcac4f4c79d40ccb141ddb6da567e65 --re-shop-reason-code 0 --selected-passengers full_name=ZHANG/SAN passenger_id=1000001 --order-id 1017035199702438072 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IntlFlightReShopCreate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rebooking product
parameters.name: ota_item_id

parameters.help_en:
The total fee for this rebooking (excluding service fees). Unit: cents.
     * Total rebooking fee = cabin upgrade fee + handling fee + tax difference (international flights have tax differences).
     * Pass this parameter when fees are involved to verify whether the price has changed
parameters.help_zh:
本次改签的总费用（不包含服务费），单位：分
     *改签总费用 = 升舱费 + 手续费 + 税差（国际有税差）
     * 建议在有费用时传入，可校验是否变价等
parameters.name: total_re_shop_fee

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the asynchronous commit pattern. If asynchronous commit is used, only a key is returned before the application result is available
parameters.help_zh: 是否采用异步提交模式，如果异步提交，返回申请结果之前，只返回一个key
parameters.name: async_apply_mode

parameters.help_en: The key for the asynchronous application
parameters.name: async_apply_key

parameters.help_en: The rebooking group key returned by the consultation API
parameters.help_zh: 咨询接口返回的改签分组key
parameters.name: passenger_journey_group_key

fields.help_en: The full name of the passenger
fields.name: full_name

parameters.help_en: The list of passengers selected for rebooking
parameters.help_zh: 选择要改签的乘机人列表
parameters.name: selected_passengers

parameters.help_en: The business travel order ID. This parameter is required
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

When calling this API over HTTP, this parameter must be included as a required parameter in the request URL. For more information about how to obtain the token, see Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
When concatenating the URL, use crop_token=value instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，推荐使用 crop_token=value 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
